key_themes: Geopolitical risk premium: US-Iran conflict is the dominant macro driver across all asset classes
Fed hawkish pivot under Warsh: rate-hike expectations reversing the easing narrative
Inflation reacceleration: oil spike + sticky core pressures force central banks to reconsider
Bond market stress: rising yields creating cross-asset contagion (equities, crypto, metals, EM)
AI monetization inflection: shift from usage-based to capacity/fixed pricing models
Regulatory evolution: SEC private markets expansion, FTC vs Amazon, consumer watchdog overhaul
Corporate leadership transition: Tim Cook exits Apple at $4T; succession risk
Consumer fragility: multiple retail bankruptcies signal demand softening in discretionary

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (XLE), reduce duration, hold 5-10% gold allocation as conflict de-escalates, monitor Brent $95-100 trigger
Shorten bond duration to 1-3Y; lock in CD rates at 4.30% APY; reduce equity beta; favor floating-rate credit
Reduce overweight in mega-cap tech; diversify into energy, utilities, healthcare; set stop-losses on positions >15% portfolio weight
TIL bonds (TIP), energy exposure, short-duration; avoid long-duration growth; monitor CPI/PCE prints
Reduce EM bond exposure; favor hard-currency EM equities; monitor Senegal/IMF deal as template for other frontier markets
Monitor AMZN for litigation impact; avoid over-concentration in ad-tech; diversify away from single-platform dependency
Favor essential/consumer staples over discretionary; watch retail bankruptcies as leading indicator

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Iran conflict and Fed hawkishness create headwinds. Expect 5-10% equity volatility, oil $90-100 range, yields testing 5.3-5.5% on 30Y. Nasdaq under pressure. Gold/silver remain suppressed by real yields. Crypto consolidates $75-85K. Key risk: further military escalation or surprise Fed hike signal.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. If Iran conflict de-escalates within 60-90 days, oil normalizes, inflation cools, and Fed pivots back. Earnings season (post-extraordinary Q2) provides support. AI monetization shift to capacity pricing validates tech revenue durability. Apple post-Cook transition and SEC private market expansion create structural tailwinds. 12-month S&P 500 target: 5,800-6,200 if no further geopolitical shock.
